results.title: Venezuelan opposition leader María Machado returns after months in exile
results.content: Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado has returned home to a fraught political landscape after more than 10 months in exile.

results.title: Northern Region NDC urges unity after internal polls, eyes 2028 victory

results.title: U/W Regional Chief Imam’s education fund supports 61 students with GH¢138,536
results.content: The Upper West Regional Chief Imam Educational Endowment Fund has disbursed GH¢138,536 to support 61 academically promising but financially disadvantaged students pursuing tertiary education nationwide.

results.title: Adongo defends GoldBod law’s passage despite opposition concerns, leaves door open to review
results.content: Parliament’s Finance Committee Chairman, Isaac Adongo, has defended the passage of the law establishing GoldBod despite opposition concerns about some provisions. He says the law can be reviewed if lapses emerge.

results.title: ‘Replace complexity with compassion’ – Cardinal Turkson urges students
results.content: The Chancellor of the Catholic University of Ghana, Cardinal Peter Appiah Turkson, has urged students to embrace compassion and collective responsibility as they prepare for a world shaped by conflict, technological disruption and uncertainty.

results.title: Foreign participation in capital market strengthens considerably in half-year 2026

results.title: Parliament’s Finance Committee has had no reason to worry over government bills – Adongo
results.content: Parliament’s Finance Committee Chairman, Isaac Adongo, says the committee has had no reason to worry about government bills brought before it, citing bipartisan scrutiny and broad agreement among members.

results.title: Oil slips from near six-month highs despite supply concerns
results.content: Oil prices fell on Monday ​after surging to near six-month highs ‌late last week, although ongoing attacks on Saudi Arabia kept supply concerns in ​focus.

results.title: Senegal party that controls parliament comes out against revised budget bill

results.title: Nigeria Ebola case linked to virus found in Kenya index case, health minister says
results.content: Genomic ​analysis of Nigeria's only confirmed Ebola case ‌shows the virus is closely related to the strain detected in Kenya's index case, Nigeria's health minister ​Muhammad Ali Pate said on Friday, offering ​the first genetic link between the outbreaks.

results.title: Fitch revises Access, Zenith, UBA, GT, 5 others outlook to positive
results.content: According to the UK-based firm, the Outlook revisions to Positive follow a similar action on Nigeria's 'B' Long-Term IDRs on 9 October 2026 that reflects ongoing reform of the policy framework and Fitch's increased confidence that momentum will not be disrupted by upcoming elections.

results.title: El Clásico: Kylian Mbappe scores twice to end Laliga leaders’ winning start

results.title: Gold Board concerns did not justify holding up law – Adongo

results.title: ‘Consummate actor has left the stage’ – Kanayo, others mourn Francis Duru
results.content: Nollywood actors have mourned the death of their colleague, Francis Duru, describing him as a talented performer whose contributions to the film industry will be remembered.

results.title: Two rescued after Nairobi building collapse, with five still missing

results.title: Gabon says access to social media restored after eight-month ban
results.content: Gabon says it has lifted a social media ban imposed eight months ago, a move that drew widespread criticism at the time.

results.title: Death toll in Nigeria village raided by gunmen rises to 48, police say
results.content: The death toll from Friday's attack on a remote village in the north-eastern Nigerian state of Taraba has risen to at least 48, police have told the BBC.

results.title: Lula wins fourth term in Brazil but faces hostile Congress and divided country
results.content: Brazil's veteran left-wing president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, has been re-elected after a bitter campaign, defeating his right-wing rival, Flávio Bolsonaro.

results.title: Gunmen kill at least 40 people in northeastern Nigeria, Amnesty International says
results.content: Gunmen killed at ​least 40 people in ‌an attack on a village in Nigeria's northeastern Taraba state on ​Friday afternoon, Amnesty International ​said.

results.title: Unemployed man jailed 10 years for attempted robbery
